narrative: Inventory optimization analysis for PL1__MCD27F63 reveals an intermittent/lumpy demand pattern (CV=1.37) with moderate lead time variability (CV=0.35). The recommended safety stock of 623 units ensures 95% service level while accounting for both demand and supply variability. The supplier variability is the dominant factor (82.1%) affecting safety stock requirements. Recommended order quantity of 2185 units balances ordering and holding costs.

research_insights.selected_model: EOQ with safety stock for intermittent demand
research_insights.selection_rationale: Given the intermittent/lumpy demand pattern (CV=1.37, 57.5% non-zero days) and moderate lead time variability, a robust EOQ model with enhanced safety stock is appropriate.
research_insights.boundary_risk: High demand variability requires careful monitoring. Consider periodic review of safety stock levels.
